title: HBR-* items
summary: Handlebar component family covering flat, riser, and swept handlebars across Manchester and Leeds stock locations.
body:
The HBR family encompasses bicycle handlebars used across assembly operations at Northbridge Cycles, catalogued across flat (FLT), riser (RIS), and swept (SWP) profiles in varying widths [^r1][^r2][^r3]. As of 09:00 GMT on 26 October 2026, inventory is held primarily at Manchester stores (WH-MAN-STR), with select variants also stocked at Leeds stores (WH-LDS-STR) [^r1][^r2][^r7][^r10][^r12]. Total stock across the family includes major commitments on order for high-demand lines such as HBR-FLT-620 and HBR-SWP-620 [^r4][^r6]. Detailed balance records are tracked through the [[data-stock-on-hand|stock on hand]] register [^r1][^r2].

## Stock on hand

| HBR-SWP-720 | WH-LDS-STR | 2,507 | 0 | 0 |

At WH-MAN-STR, stock for HBR-FLT-580 stands at 2,443 on hand, 175 allocated, and 0 on order [^r1]. Stock for HBR-RIS-580 is 188 on hand, 0 allocated, and 0 on order at WH-MAN-STR, with 19 on hand, 0 allocated, and 0 on order at WH-LDS-STR [^r2]. Handlebar HBR-SWP-580 has 15 on hand, 2 allocated, and 0 on order at WH-MAN-STR [^r3].

For 620 mm variants, HBR-FLT-620 holds 2,295 on hand, 1,404 allocated, and 9,000 on order at WH-MAN-STR [^r4]. HBR-RIS-620 has 12 on hand, 4 allocated, and 50 on order at WH-MAN-STR [^r5]. HBR-SWP-620 records 7,723 on hand, 185 allocated, and 2,500 on order at WH-MAN-STR [^r6].

For 680 mm components, HBR-FLT-680 has 17,740 on hand, 1,577 allocated, and 0 on order at WH-MAN-STR, alongside 2,532 on hand, 0 allocated, and 0 on order at WH-LDS-STR [^r7]. HBR-RIS-680 maintains 16,589 on hand, 297 allocated, and 0 on order at WH-MAN-STR [^r8]. HBR-SWP-680 has 2,913 on hand, 127 allocated, and 0 on order at WH-MAN-STR [^r9].

For 720 mm items, HBR-FLT-720 shows 12 on hand, 1 allocated, and 0 on order at WH-MAN-STR, with 5 on hand, 0 allocated, and 0 on order at WH-LDS-STR [^r10]. HBR-RIS-720 holds 168 on hand, 11 allocated, and 0 on order at WH-MAN-STR [^r11]. HBR-SWP-720 stands at 15,728 on hand, 406 allocated, and 0 on order at WH-MAN-STR, plus 2,507 on hand, 0 allocated, and 0 on order at WH-LDS-STR [^r12].
